pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided dark regions with smooth-to-blurry pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is largest on the upper neck and transitions to significantly smaller, more frequent geometric units on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored negative space. Pathways are thickest on the neck and shoulder, narrowing into a more complex topological graph of thin lineaments on the lower torso and hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, stiff mane along the dorsal neck exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Three avian organisms (oxpeckers) are perched on the lateral and dorsal surfaces of the neck and shoulder region.
